extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Cigna plan available in Lee County has a $15 monthly premium, a $205 drug deductible and a $6000 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. The agent also scheduled the appointment 4 hours after sending the Scope of Appointment.
composition.coaching_note: Great job, Marcus! You followed all the necessary steps and ensured compliance. One area for improvement is to remind the customer to review the Scope of Appointment before signing it to ensure they understand the terms.
